sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Mi a... ? asks for information identified by a noun: Mi a *címed*? Mi a *telefonszámod*?

items.spanish: A telefonszámom nulla hat, harminc, egy kettő három, négy öt hat hét.

sections.content: *Mi a*...? is a template you can keep reusing — swap in any noun after *a* and you’ve built a new question. *Címed* (‘your address’) and *telefonszámod* (‘your phone number’) both end in a possessive ‘-d’ meaning ‘your,’ a pattern about to become one of the most useful little suffixes in your whole vocabulary.
